what_is_it.explanation: Scroll-craft is an agent skill designed to work with coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to build scroll-driven, immersive websites. It treats interaction and craft as a single job, incorporating strict rules for typography, page grammars, and visual depth. It also features a verification pass using a headless browser to catch dead scroll and rendering errors.
